div.div: 2 وصّصت , (AZ, TA,) or ↓ وَصْوَصَتْ , (M,) She (a girl, M,) put on, or wore, her نِقَاب [a kind of fare-veil], (AZ, TA,) or her قِنَاع [a kind of head-covering], (M,) in such a manner that nothing was seen but her eyes: (AZ, M, TA:) تَوْصِيصٌ and تَرْصِيصٌ signify the same: (AZ, S, CK:) the former is of the dial. of Temeem: (AZ, TA:) or both the above verbs signify she (a woman) contracted her نقاب (K, TA) so that it shewed nothing but her eyes: (TA:) or وصوصت signifies she (a woman) put her نقاب near to her eyes. (Fr. TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
